messages:
violet: FYI I discovered a Pastebin post that contains a KMS-wrapped ciphertext blob which references one of our CMKs. paste URL is redacted in the ticket. moving to quarantine and looping sec.

mark: can you paste a safe-redacted header and which key it references? also who had write access to the repo/bucket that the artifact came from?

violet: header (redacted): `gcp_kms_v1|projects/redwood-ops/locations/global/keyRings/sdk-kr/cryptoKeys/sdk-wrap|v1|meta:sdk-backup` . artifact was uploaded by a third-party SDK integration to a partner mirror bucket `s3://partner-sdk-dumps/2026-03-20/`. ACLs show partner-ci role (put/get) and our infra svcacct `redwood-integ@infra` (read).

sam: created INC-2026-204. initial severity P2 (suspected credential exposure limited to partner-integrations). checklist: quarantine copy, export object access logs, query KMS decrypt audit, and RBAC review.

jin: sec-bot runbooks: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/thirdparty-credential-leak and kms-rotation runbook referenced. immediate asks: 1) export S3 access logs for that prefix (30d), 2) query CloudTrail for Decrypt on `sdk-wrap`, 3) snapshot object checksums.

sec-bot: [AUTO] detection=0.75; rule=paste-exposed-kms-ciphertext; recommended_action=quarantine+rekey; checklist_added=export-logs,quarantine-copy,create-key-version,revoke-old-decrypt,partner-notify,postmortem

mark: I ran a quick CloudTrail filter for Decrypt against that key and see two Decrypt events in the last 14 days from `serviceAccount:partner-sdk-runner@partners.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. no other principals.

violet: quarantine copy done: `aws s3 cp s3://partner-sdk-dumps/2026-03-20/sdk_bundle.tar.gz s3://sec-quarantine/6360000000-sdk_bundle.tar.gz` (not unpacking outside secure env). sha256=2a9f... stored in INC-2026-204.

sam: RBAC mitigation suggestion: temporarily remove `cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt` binding from non-infra principals on the key (partner/sdk-runner). create scoped deny for the partner role on the key resource. schedule a low-impact window 02:00-03:00 PT. Jin, agree?

jin: agree. Also we need to decide whether to rotate the CMK or request partner to rotate inner creds. Since our CMK is referenced, create a new key version (v2) and plan to rewrap quarantined artifacts in secure project. partner must rotate any inner secrets themselves.

mark: quick forensic note: check Vault audit for any `transit/decrypt` or unwrap calls that line up with those Decrypt times. if inner secrets were unwrapped in our environment, escalate to P1.

violet: checked Vault audit in secure project: no corresponding unwrap/unseal activity. looks like partner CI may have performed decrypts in their own runtime. blast radius limited but still sensitive.

sam: I'll create the key version in a secure project and list the permission delta we plan to apply: 1) create v2, 2) remove decrypt from partner-runner on old version, 3) rewrap quarantined object in secure env with v2, 4) if no breakage, enforce new-key only.

jin: draft partner outreach: "We discovered a KMS-wrapped artifact in a public paste/mirror that references a Redwood-managed KMS key. We have quarantined a copy and are rotating the wrapping key. Please rotate any credentials referenced by that artifact and confirm by EOD." send via partner-ops and cc bizops.

sec-bot: [AUTO] checklist_update: export-logs done?no; quarantine-copy done?yes; create-key-version pending; revoke-old-decrypt pending; rewrap pending; partner-notify pending; postmortem pending

mark: SRE note: removing decrypt permission for partner-runner will block some partner onboarding flows. propose 1-hour maintenance window and inform devex. minimal user impact expected.

violet: assigning tasks: violet -> quarantine copy + partner comms draft; mark -> audit logs + forensic checksum; sam -> key-version creation + rewrap script; jin -> RBAC patch + incident lead + postmortem owner. target: RBAC apply and key-version created within 6h, rewrap sweep in 24h, full postmortem in 72h.

violet: added checksum and evidence to INC-2026-204. updating when RBAC applied. :thumbsup:
